title.zh: 授权宿务省达瑙市镇的达瑙国立医院接受杜拉诺公司与环球水泥公司以现金、物资、设备或药品等任何形式提供的捐赠的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Danao National Hospital in the Municipality of Danao, Province of Cebu, to Accept Donations in Any Form, Whether in Cash, Materials, Equipment or Medicines, from the Durano and Company, Inc. and the Universal Cement Company, Inc
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Danao National Hospital in the Municipality of Danao, Province of Cebu, to Accept Donations in Any Form, Whether in Cash, Materials, Equipment or Medicines, from the Durano and Company, Inc. and the Universal Cement Company, Inc

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2255_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Danao National Hospital in the Municipality of Danao, Province of Cebu, is hereby authorized to accept donations in any form, whether in cash, materials, equipment of medicines, from the Durano and Company, Inc., and the Universal Cement Company, Inc., for the operation and maintenance of said hospital.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1959.
